results.title: Bolding not happy despite Parkview’s lopsided win over Wynne
results.description: Little Rock Parkview came out of the gates quickly, scoring four unanswered first quarter touchdowns before cruising to a 45-21 victory over Wynne in the first round of the Class 5A state playoffs Friday night at War Memorial Stadium in Little Rock.

results.title: Heritage football season ends in triple-overtime, first-round heartbreaker
results.description: CONYERS — After rallying from a 21-point score deficit, Heritage fell to New Manchester 38-36 in a three-overtime heartbreaker in the first round of the Class AAAAAA state football playoffs on Friday.

results.title: Will Young says Jasprit Bumrah’s return will make India-New Zealand Test series challenging
results.description: New Zealand batter Will Young believes Jasprit Bumrah's return will pose a major challenge in the upcoming Test series against India. However, he backed his team's bowling attack to test the visitors, recalling the confidence gained from their 2024 series win.
